name: laeeq
description: This website presents Laeeq Aslam's current research profile. The main GTIIT project is low-cost drone-based wind estimation and wind-field reconstruction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). Parallel research lines include physics-guided forecasting for wind-energy and grid-reliability systems, and climate-risk intelligence for urban heat and infrastructure resilience.
